title: The Matrix Hub: Second Reboot & Codec Down
summary: Return to the Hub! The Old Bearded Coder takes your new RAM + GPU chips, upgrades the Matrix server (`cat open_weights_node2.conf`, `cat dad.tty.sock`), and reboots Kiro.d with Open-Weight Model #2 (`kiro load deepseek`) to disable Codec!

files.content:
=== MATRIX BARE-METAL SERVER // OPEN-WEIGHTS NODE #2 ===
OLD BEARDED CODER: *flicks cigarette ash into an empty coffee mug as green hex streams across his glasses*
"Oh, you've found more RAM and GPU parts for hosting our second open-weight model, nice!"
"When my enterprise bosses forced us onto cloud LLMs, Codec replaced half my team's code with hallucinated slop. Let's return the favor."

[SERVER SOFT READY]:
  1. Check in with the Old Bearded Coder (`cat dad.tty.sock` or `dad`).
  2. Reboot Kiro.d with the second open-weight model: `kiro load deepseek` (`deepseek-r1-distill-q4.gguf`).
  3. Watch Kiro.d disable Codec of the Big Four, then advance via `cd sector_docker_forge`!
